verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents capturing vendor receipts and bills by mobile scan, drag-and-drop upload or a dedicated inbox, and paying invoices directly from sevDesk through connected bank accounts. That covers the capture and payment ends of the AP workflow. Nothing in the evidence shows an approval routing step, and paying immediately is not the same as scheduling a payment for a future date. missing for 10: approval routing/approver workflow, scheduled or future-dated payments, evidence that capture-to-payment runs as a single workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow

citations.quote: Scan your receipts with the mobile app, upload them using drag & drop or send them directly to your sevdesk inbox.
pay your invoices directly from sevdesk
Map invoices directly to your bank payments.
